title: Graph Node
description: Shared interchange format for graph nodes. Used by EntityGraph output and Nexus graph. Every node must reference the Memory drawers that evidence it (drawer_ids). Consumers: nexus, shift, entity-graph.

type.description: Entity type. Three canonical types — see entity-graph expansion rule.

label.description: Human-readable label. The part after '::' in the id.

drawer_count.description: Number of Memory drawers in which this entity appears.

drawer_ids.description: List of drawer_id values from Memory drawers that evidence this entity. Required by Nexus architecture (A5). Empty array only acceptable when no drawers exist.
